cohortRestriction.newVersionEntryRule: Starts progressively with the respective grade in which Biology begins. The portal does not prescribe one universal Biology entry grade for all schools.
cohortRestriction.oldVersionEntryRule: 2023 remains applicable only to the run-out grades/cohorts; validity ends grade by grade. It is neither a blanket current Sek-I source nor entirely invalid from 2026/27.
cohortRestriction.cohortInferenceLimit: School curriculum/subject-start grade and actual cohort/version must be established. Neither current grade alone nor jurisdiction, phase, source effectiveFrom, publication year, or learner mastery establishes source version. Repetition/transfers require actual curriculum evidence.
cohortRestriction.conditionalExample: Only if Biology begins in J5 and cohorts progress normally: 2026/27 J5 uses 2026, J6–J10 remain 2023; 2027/28 J5–J6 use 2026. This is an illustrative consequence, not a universal official grade assignment.
cohortRestriction.sekII: Current portal explicitly says the Sek-II part is carried over unchanged from 2023; the lower-cohort restriction must not be used to manufacture a changed Sek-II curriculum.
cohortRestriction.endDate: No single source-wide expiry date is justified by the verified portal rule.

Closed published sourceDocument has IDs, sourceKey, title, role, semanticType, official URL/landing URL and optional durationModel. No cohort/date selection fields.
Closed publication mapping edge has sourceGoalId, canonicalGoalId, exact/partial matchType; no cohort selector.
Only jurisdiction compiles. Partial still adds the jurisdiction, and non-partial input types become exact. A partial flip alone cannot enforce run-out cohorts or prevent mandatory exposure.
Source document output keeps identity/title/URL/path/role/official; no temporal or cohort enforcement appears in the inspected route.
